copy.caption: Full day-by-day itinerary in the first comment. Four cities, one trip: Beijing, Xi'an, Hangzhou and Shanghai, with a high-speed train from Beijing to Xi'an. Flights, hotels, an English-speaking tour guide and the meals listed in the itinerary are in the price. NZD $4,080 per person, twin share; single supplement NZD $800. Travel insurance and tips are not included. Next departure 11 March 2027.
